description: This file contains functions for stripping and parsing inbound metadata blocks injected into user messages, including handling timestamp prefixes, sentinel markers, and JSON-encoded metadata. It is used to clean message text before display in UI surfaces, ensuring AI-facing metadata does not appear to users.

methods.name: stripInboundMetadata
methods.description: Removes all injected inbound metadata prefix blocks from the input text, including timestamp prefixes and structured JSON blocks.

methods.name: stripLeadingInboundMetadata
methods.description: Removes inbound metadata blocks from the beginning of the message text, handling sentinel markers and JSON fences.

methods.name: extractInboundSenderLabel
methods.description: Extracts sender label or identifier from the inbound message metadata.
